title: Tiny Desk pets
notes: Full pack for the 17.76s vertical 720x1280 Tiny Desk remake. Editorial generation segments are 0–12s and 12–17.76s so the hook close-up stays intact and the sub-4s sax and return beats share a segment. The automatic whole-beat planner would instead cut at 6s (6s + 11.76s), which is also inside 4–12s. An even time split would be 8.88s + 8.88s and would slice the hook. The source video is not in this repo. See examples/tiny-desk-pets-5s-test.json for the cheap test.

storyBeats.summary: Cramped shelf-packed office. The keys pet pounds a red keyboard at center in a black jacket and headset. Left backup in a white hoodie and right backup in a red track jacket sway beside vintage mics. Locked medium-wide, warm practicals.
Hard cut to a tight close-up of the lead in a red cap and red-and-black hoodie, mouthing the hook, then raising a paw and pointing. A saxophone edge may enter, never replacing the lead.
Medium profile of the sax pet in a navy-and-white hoodie and headphones on a gold sax. The keys pet's snout sits lower-right beside a silver mic stand.
Hard cut back to the locked medium-wide band. Keys pet on the red keyboard, left backup swaying, right backup pointing upward, mouths on the beat.
